newsitem.title: UK: GOLDMAN SACHS TIPPED AS LEAD FOR INKOMBANK BOND.
newsitem.headline: GOLDMAN SACHS TIPPED AS LEAD FOR INKOMBANK BOND.

text.p: Goldman Sachs has been strongly tipped as lead manager of a dollar Eurobond for Russia's fourth largest bank by assets, Inkombank, syndicate sources said on Friday.
AB Inkombank said Friday it planned to issue a total of $500 million Eurobonds, with the first $200 million issue to be launched in November.
Goldman Sachs declined to comment on the transaction.
Bankers said the maturity was likely to be for three to five years, with a size dependent on market conditions at the time of launch.
In July, Russia's Unexim issued a $200 million three-year bond to yield 400 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes.
The bond was last trading at around 375 basis points over, dealers said.
That transaction, rated Ba3 by Moody's Investors Service, could be used when pricing a deal for Inkombank, dealers said.
Russian banks SBS-AGRO and Alfa have also tapped the Eurobond market recently.
